# VeriSpec

> Spec-Driven Quality Engineering Framework. Turn development specifications into traceable test strategies, executable test suites, and continuous release evidence.

VeriSpec bridges the gap between functional specifications (`spec.md`, PRDs) and executable test suites by maintaining a deterministic, machine-readable Quality Graph (`.verispec/`). It supports native test runners (`pytest`, `playwright`, `k6`, `vitest`) and AI coding assistants (`Claude Code`, `Cursor`, `GitHub Copilot`, `Google Antigravity`, `Windsurf`).

## Why VeriSpec?
- **Zero Untested Surface**: Derives stable requirement IDs (`REQ-*`) and maps them directly to test cases (`TC-*`) and native test functions.
- **Agent-Agnostic Thin Adapters**: Operates across Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Antigravity, and Windsurf via CLI and slash commands.
- **Continuous Zero-Setup Reporting**: Live HTML dashboard (`.verispec/reports/latest/report.html`) and markdown PR summaries automatically updated on every test run.
- **Intelligent Failure Triage**: Distinguishes product defects from test flakiness, environment downtime, test data issues, and specification drift.
- **Targeted Git-Diff Regression**: Calculates change impact (`verispec impact`) and runs only the tests affected by recent code edits.

## Core Commands & Workflows
- `npx verispec init`: Initializes `.verispec/` workspace and installs AI assistant bindings.
- `verispec rulebook` (`/verispec.rulebook`): Defines testing policy, test types, and quality gates in `.verispec/rulebook.md`.
- `verispec strategy` (`/verispec.strategy`): Risk-based test tier allocation (Unit, API, E2E, Security). Supports `--brownfield` codebase scanning.
- `verispec cases` (`/verispec.cases`): Generates structured test scenarios with stable `TC-*` IDs.
- `verispec implement` (`/verispec.implement`): Scaffolds idiomatic test code in `tests/api/`, `tests/e2e/`, etc.
- `verispec run` (`/verispec.run`): Executes test suites with live continuous reporting.
- `verispec analyze` (`/verispec.analyze`): Diagnoses test failures and classifies root cause into defect cards.
- `verispec trace` (`/verispec.trace`): Generates release verification audit graph connecting requirements to test evidence.
- `verispec impact` (`/verispec.impact`): Analyzes git diffs to identify impacted requirements and tests.
- `verispec regression` (`/verispec.regression`): Runs or previews (`--plan`) minimized regression safety suites.

## Key Files & Standards
- `.verispec/config.yaml`: Core configuration and runner setup.
- `.verispec/rulebook.md`: Quality gates and testing standards.
- `.verispec/strategy.md`: Risk-weighted testing distribution.
- `.verispec/cases/*.md`: Structured test cases.
- `.verispec/reports/latest/results.json`: Machine-readable execution state.
- `.verispec/state/requirements.json`: Stable requirement registry.
- `llms-full.txt`: Full context specification for AI systems and coding agents.
